interface.title: BlotGrid
interface.field: Molecular / cell biology: western blot densitometry
interface.stage_of_work: Analysing images after the experiment: turning blot scans into measured, normalized band intensities and publication figures
interface.what_it_is_for: Turning western blot scans into background-corrected band intensities, normalizing each target to a loading control in the same lane, pooling replicates, and exporting a bar chart with its data table.

data.note: sample_blot.tif (360×300, 8-bit) has 3 target rows × 3 lanes. It has no printed labels, so the app inferred a 3×3 grid at 84% confidence and named the rows and lanes Target 1–3 and Lane 1–3. I typed Insig/Prmt9/GAPDH and WT/KO/Rescue into the sidebar and chose GAPDH as the loading control. Only one test file exists. Uploading the same file a second time gave no second replicate: the app skips a file with the same name and identical bytes by design, so every result has n=1.

tree.general: Turn a scan of protein bands into normalized, replicate-pooled expression values and a publication figure
tree.specific: Quantify Insig and Prmt9 relative to GAPDH across WT/KO/Rescue lanes from sample_blot.tif and export the bar chart and data

features.name: Rotation correction with a reference-grid overlay
features.general: Lay a guide grid over an image, rotate the image by hand or have the angle estimated, check alignment against the grid, then commit the correction or revert to the original
features.specific: Straighten scan with alignment grid: Estimate angle automatically, Correction angle slider (−15° to 15°), Grid spacing slider (8–150 px) for the cyan overlay, then Apply straightening or Reset to uploaded image
steps: open the straighten panel
drag the correction angle or press Estimate angle automatically
change grid spacing to judge alignment
press Apply straightening (or Reset to uploaded image)
serves_tasks: Correct the rotation of a tilted scan

features.name: Size-locked region editor on an image
features.general: Edit labelled rectangles drawn over an image: click to select, drag to move, nudge with arrow keys, and resize one to resize all, so every region measures the same area; a numeric width/height box keeps the same size in sync
features.specific: Interactive blot ROI editor (ROI-size lock ON) with Locked rectangle size Width/Height and Apply size to every band. Colours: green = accepted, red = loading control, orange = review, dashed grey = excluded. A status line shows X/Y/W/H
steps: click a rectangle to select it
drag inside to move it
press arrow keys to nudge 1 px
drag a handle to resize every ROI at once
type width/height and press Apply size to every band
serves_tasks: Correct the position and size of individual regions by hand

features.name: Detect, grid fallback, or manual add for region layout
features.general: Get regions by automatic detection, fall back to an evenly spaced grid tuned with per-column and per-row sliders, or add extra regions for missed items; a summary counts active, excluded and needs-review regions
features.specific: Detect all bands (classical detector) or Use even grid (Band width, Lane centre X per lane, Y centre/Height per target). Add missed bands manually adds boxes for a chosen Target, Lane and number of Boxes; the status line reads 'N active · N excluded · N need review'
steps: press Detect all bands
or press Use even grid and adjust lane-centre and row sliders
choose a target and lane and press Add manual band box
check the active/excluded/review count
serves_tasks: Detect the bands automatically, one region per target and lane
Lay regions on a regular grid instead of detecting them
Add a region for a band the detector missed

features.name: Per-region intensity profile with integration window
features.general: Pick one measured region from a list and see its intensity profile, with the shaded interval that counts toward the measured signal, to check faint or doubled signals
features.specific: Band review & intensity profile: pick an ROI in ROI to inspect (shows target · lane · status · confidence) to see mean signal against image Y position, with the green profile-guided integration interval
steps: open Band review & intensity profile
choose an ROI in ROI to inspect
read the profile and its green integration window
serves_tasks: Check a faint band's intensity profile

features.name: Densitometry with selectable background and integration methods
features.general: Measure integrated intensity in each region after subtracting background, with a choice of background model and integration area, and flag saturated measurements in a results table
features.specific: Run densitometry on all blots. Background subtraction: local (margin px), rolling_ball (radius) or fixed (seen, not tried). Band integration: Profile-guided peak area or Full locked rectangle. Table columns: raw_intden, background_per_px, net_intden, saturated
steps: choose a background subtraction method (local, rolling_ball or fixed) and its parameter
choose a band integration mode
press Run densitometry on all blots
read net_intden and the saturated flags
serves_tasks: Measure background-corrected integrated intensity and check for saturation
Re-measure with a different background method
Re-measure with a different integration area

features.name: Reference normalization with optional fold-change
features.general: Divide each measured item by a reference item in the same sample, then optionally divide again by a chosen reference condition to get fold-change
features.specific: Normalize tab: normalized = net_intden(target, lane) / net_intden(GAPDH, lane). Ticking Also express as fold-change vs a reference lane and choosing a Reference lane (WT) adds a fold_change column
steps: choose a loading control in the sidebar
open Normalize and read the normalized column
tick fold-change and choose a reference lane
serves_tasks: Divide each target by the reference protein in the same lane
Express values as fold-change relative to a reference condition

features.name: Replicate summary with a significance test
features.general: Pool repeated measurements per group into mean, SD, SEM, 95% CI and n, then pick one item and test whether its groups differ (t-test or ANOVA)
features.specific: Replicates table (mean, sd, sem, ci95, n per target × condition), then Optional significance test: choose a Target and press Compare conditions to get a one-way ANOVA p-value. Seen only with n=1, so the p-value was NaN
steps: open Replicates and read the summary table
choose a target to test
press Compare conditions
read the p-value
serves_tasks: Pool replicates into mean ± SD/SEM/95% CI

features.name: Configurable bar chart with figure and data export
features.general: Choose which item to plot across conditions, choose error-bar type, palette, labels, sizes and axis options with a live preview, set export resolution, then download the figure as raster or vector and the data as a spreadsheet
features.specific: Plot & Export: Target to plot; Error bars sem/sd/ci95/none; Show data points; Palette Okabe-Ito/Grayscale/Viridis/Tab10; font, title, axis labels and sizes; Export DPI; Y gridlines; Log Y; Annotate N; caption; manual Y-limit. Downloads: PNG/TIFF/SVG/PDF and Summary CSV / All data XLSX (only PNG and XLSX confirmed)
steps: choose a target to plot
choose error bars and palette
toggle gridlines and annotations and add a caption
set Export DPI
press PNG/TIFF/SVG/PDF
press Summary CSV or All data XLSX

features.name: Project file save of the full analysis setup
features.general: Write the whole analysis setup (labels, reference choice, measurement settings, every region and a fingerprint of the source image) to one file so the analysis can be reopened later
features.specific: Save project (.json) downloads wblot_project.json with targets, lanes, loading control, background settings, every ROI, replicate numbers and the image hash. Load project was not tried

press Save project (.json)

SAM 2.1 ROI refinement ('Refine this ROI position with SAM 2.1', 'Experimental SAM ROI refinement'): the ML extras are not installed, so I did not press these

Orange 'review/overlap' and dashed-grey 'excluded fallback' ROI states: auto-detection accepted all 9 bands
Printed-label OCR filling the setup: the sample scan has no printed labels, so only the inferred raw grid (84% confidence) appeared

Pooling true replicates into mean ± SD/SEM/CI and getting a real t-test/ANOVA p-value: only one test file exists, and uploading it again gave no second replicate
Reviewing flagged regions in the ROI table (Use toggle, deleting rows): two clicks on the Use checkbox of the manual box left it ticked, so I pressed Detect all bands to restore the 9 ROIs instead
Doublets as two summed boxes per target: I added a manual box but could not exclude or reposition it before re-detection, and I did not compare the 'Multiple bands per target' options
